hypothesis: Increasing the public FPGA reference's per-block and per-DTS generation thresholds will overcome the observed seventh-row stall and yield a valid scope-111 DTS, even at lower trial throughput.
rationale: The separated-training reference completed 100 training trials and repeatedly reached six populated rows, but its default BLOCK_GEN_THRESH=100 and DTS_GEN_THRESH=200000 ended every observed target trial before the seventh row. The threshold change directly tests whether the failure is insufficient persistence in the reversible deletion search rather than incompatible learned mark distributions.
expected_information_gain: Distinguishes a finite attempt-budget bottleneck at the seventh-row boundary from a deeper failure of the public FPGA search distribution for the frozen target.
method: Use the pinned public dts-search-hdl source at commit 2ccff8e767c3fe6390fd3af056dfda11847011fc, adapted to n=7,k=5,M=111 with deterministic seed 20260902 and TRAINING_M=152, TRAINING_TRIALS=100. Retain all bit-parallel spectrum, Gaussian training, reversible deletion, and row construction logic, changing only BLOCK_GEN_THRESH from 100 to 1000 and DTS_GEN_THRESH from 200000 to 2000000 in the temporary build source. Compile with WSL gcc -Wall -Ofast and run for 120 seconds; parse and independently verify any decoded rows.
metric: decoded candidate, independent DTS validity, scope, populated-row depth, completed target trials, and runtime
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A verifier-valid decoded seven-row assignment with scope<=111 is exactly a true-objective witness; populated depth and trial count are diagnostics only.
kill_condition: Stop at the first independently validated scope-111 witness or after 120 seconds; preserve complete stdout/stderr and transformed-source hashes. Do not infer infeasibility from timeout.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if complete and validator-valid

previous_best_comparison.fpga_reference_002: 100 separated-training trials; repeated target depth 6 under default thresholds
previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: same source family with persistence thresholds increased

interpretation: Pre-registered FPGA-reference threshold experiment; no candidate claim is made before execution.
recommended_next_action: If a valid scope-111 witness appears, freeze and independently/adversarially verify it and perform prior-art review; otherwise pause this software reference family pending hardware-scale execution or a new mathematical construction.
repetition_justification: This is a targeted test of the observed seventh-row attempt-budget bottleneck, not a generic runtime or seed sweep; training, target, source algorithm, and verifier remain fixed.
